title: Switch Frame Tap
description: Stream gameplay and audio to a PC without a capture card.
author: TomasUribe
details:
Switch Frame Tap is a sysmodule for streaming gameplay and audio to a PC over USB or the network. It uses the H.264 encoder and supports up to 1080p60fps where available.

It supports native-resolution screenshots, recording through the PC viewer, network streaming, and USB webcam mode.

A reboot is required after installation or updating so the sysmodule can restart.
changelog:
v0.7.21.1

v0.7.21.1: games started from SwitchU stream from their first frame

**Fixes**
- **SwitchU: a game started from its menu streams from its first frame.** While a game loaded, the stream took the long pause for going HOME and set itself up again, so the picture came up to 3 s late (Mario Kart 8 Deluxe: 1.5 s; now 0.2 s). Without SwitchU nothing changes.

Everything else is as in [v0.7.21](https://github.com/TomasUribe/switch-frame-tap/releases/tag/v0.7.21) (SwitchU support, Final Fantasy XII in handheld). **Viewers:** the same as v0.7.20.

**Updating:** open the Switch app's **Updates** page (or unzip `switch-frame-tap-0.7.21.1-switch.zip` over the SD card root) and restart the console. Settings are kept.
